elevation.$description: Confirmed via Figma variables (Drop shadow/*) and cross-checked against all 5 apps' Tailwind boxShadow config — already identical everywhere, no ratification conflict. Just needed one shared home.

xsmall.$description: Confirmed again via the Input Field/Box component's named 'Drop shadow/XSmall' variable (removed entirely in the Disabled state).

focus-ring.$description: New token, confirmed via Input Field/Box's Focused and Typing states — a 4px solid-color ring, not a blurred shadow. Color (#E1E1FE) is close to but not identical to primary-100 (#E0E2FF), a small drift in the same shape as the brand-gold one. Only appears on the Box input style; the Line style changes only its border color on focus, no ring.
